# UKHomePack

> UKHomePack creates online UK property information reports for buyers, sellers and property professionals. The service brings together available public and official records into an online report and downloadable PDF.

UKHomePack is an independent service for initial property research. A report may include available HM Land Registry sale history and tenure, EPC information, council tax, planning applications, flood-risk findings, crime statistics, schools, healthcare, broadband and mobile coverage. Availability and publication dates vary by address and source. A missing result is not evidence that no issue exists.

Retail reports cost £9.99 for one property. Business membership costs £49 per month and includes unlimited reports. Business Plus costs £79 per month and adds company branding. Current pricing and terms on the website take precedence over this summary.

UKHomePack reports do not replace a building survey, valuation, legal advice, title documents, conveyancing searches or statutory local-authority searches.

## Main pages

- [UK property reports](https://ukhomepack.com/): Service overview and one-off report purchase.
- [Report contents](https://ukhomepack.com/features): Checks and data sources included in a report.
- [Pricing](https://ukhomepack.com/pricing): Retail, Business and Business Plus prices.
- [Sample property report](https://ukhomepack.com/sample): Illustrative report showing the presentation and limitations.
- [Property checks before buying](https://ukhomepack.com/buyer-guide): UK homebuyer checklist and guidance.
- [Seller guide](https://ukhomepack.com/seller-guide): Information to prepare before selling a property.
- [Council tax band checker](https://ukhomepack.com/council-tax): Exact-address VOA band lookup and available charges.
- [Broadband checker](https://ukhomepack.com/broadband): Available Ofcom broadband information by address.
- [Mobile coverage checker](https://ukhomepack.com/mobile): Available Ofcom mobile coverage information by address.
- [Machine-readable site information](https://ukhomepack.com/site-info.json): JSON summary of the organisation, service, prices and important limitations.
